name: Accessible Soft 3D & Tactile Claymorphism
designThesis: Tactile, friendly, rounded 3D interface architecture engineered with double inset/outset shadows and soft pastel surfaces, calibrated specifically to overcome historical neumorphic contrast deficiencies by enforcing high-contrast text and explicit component boundaries.
bestFitContexts: Wellness, mental health, and meditation applications
Friendly educational platforms and interactive learning suites
Consumer finance budgeting apps and savings trackers
Creative onboarding flows and interactive product wizards
poorFitContexts: Institutional legal compliance and forensic audit logs

colorStrategy.canvasTone: Soft warm lavender or mint off-white (#F5F3FF / #F0FDF4)
colorStrategy.accentUsage: Pastel lavender, soft sky blue, and warm peach surfaces paired with high-contrast slate text
colorStrategy.contrastTarget: Strict 4.5:1 AA minimum for all text against soft surfaces

typographyStrategy.fontPairing: Fredoka or Varela Round paired with Nunito Sans
typographyStrategy.hierarchyEmphasis: Rounded, approachable headings with generous line-height and soft weight curves

layoutRhythm.gridStructure: Organic grid containers with generous interior padding and smooth transitions

surfaceTreatment.borderStyle: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) with subtle contrasting boundary line
surfaceTreatment.depthElevation: Double shadow volume: inset -3px -3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 6px 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)

componentGuidelines.primaryActionStyle: Chunky clay pill button with soft spring-physics bounce on press
componentGuidelines.cardStructure: Embossed tactile cards with clear boundary contrast and spacious padding
componentGuidelines.tablePresentation: Rounded container table with soft pill row highlights

accessibilityProfile.keyboardHandling: Prominent focus ring with high-contrast color contrasting against pastel surfaces
accessibilityProfile.reducedMotionRules: Disable bounce physics and scale animations on user preference

antiPatterns: Low-contrast white text on light pastel buttons
Disappearing form input borders lacking explicit UI boundary contrast
Excessive shadow blur that impairs reading clarity
Uncalibrated inset shadows causing hollow or sunken text appearance

browserChecks: Verify rounded corner rendering across mobile and desktop browsers
Verify double shadow contrast on both light and dark backgrounds
